SELECT
    (req->>'$.timestamp') AS timestamp,
    (req->>'$.max_connections') AS max_connections,
    (req->>'$.total_connections') AS total_connections,
    (req->>'$.version') AS version,
    (req->>'$.node_name') AS node_name,
    (req->>'$.group_id') AS group_id,
    (req->>'$.spotlight') AS spotlight,
    (req->>'$.connections') AS conenctions
FROM session_webhook
WHERE (req->>'$.session_id') :: VARCHAR = $session_id
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH connections_list AS (
  SELECT
    (req->>'$.timestamp') AS timestamp,
    (req->>'$.connections') AS connections
  FROM session_webhook
  WHERE (req->>'$.session_id') :: VARCHAR = $session_id
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    value ->> 'connection_id' AS connection_id,
    value ->> 'role' AS role,
    value ->> 'client_id' AS client_id,
    value ->> 'audio' AS audio,
    value ->> 'video' AS video,
    value ->> 'simulcast' AS simulcast,
    value ->> 'connection_created_timestamp' AS connection_created_timestamp,
    value ->> 'connection_destroyed_timestamp' AS connection_destroyed_timestamp,
FROM connections_list,
     json_each(connections_list.connections, '$');

SELECT
  time_bucket($__interval, timestamp) AS time,
  connection_id AS connection_id,
  rtc_id AS inbound_rtp_audio_rtc_id,
  (rtc_data->>'$.jitter') :: double AS jitter,
  (rtc_data->>'$.packetsLost') :: numeric AS packets_lost,
  (rtc_data->>'$.packetsReceived') :: numeric AS packets_received,
  (rtc_data->>'$.packetsDiscarded') :: numeric AS packets_discarded,
  (rtc_data->>'$.fecPacketsReceived') :: numeric AS fec_packets_received,
  (rtc_data->>'$.fecPacketsDiscarded') :: numeric AS fec_packets_discarded,
  (rtc_data->>'$.bytesReceived') :: numeric AS bytes_received,
  (rtc_data->>'$.headerBytesReceived') :: numeric AS header_bytes_received,
  (rtc_data->>'$.lastPacketReceivedTimestamp') :: double AS last_packet_received_timestamp,
  (rtc_data->>'$.jitterBufferDelay') :: double AS jitter_buffer_delay,
  (rtc_data->>'$.jitterBufferTargetDelay') :: double AS jitter_buffer_target_delay,
  (rtc_data->>'$.jitterBufferMinimumDelay') :: double AS jitter_buffer_minimum_delay,
  (rtc_data->>'$.jitterBufferEmittedCount') :: numeric AS jitter_buffer_emitted_count,
  (rtc_data->>'$.totalSamplesReceived') :: numeric AS total_samples_received,
  (rtc_data->>'$.concealedSamples') :: numeric AS concealed_samples,
  (rtc_data->>'$.silentConcealedSamples') :: numeric AS silent_concealed_samples,
  (rtc_data->>'$.concealmentEvents') :: numeric AS concealment_events,
  (rtc_data->>'$.insertedSamplesForDeceleration') :: numeric AS inserted_samples_for_deceleration,
  (rtc_data->>'$.removedSamplesForAcceleration') :: numeric AS removed_samples_for_acceleration,
  (rtc_data->>'$.audioLevel') :: double AS audio_level,
  (rtc_data->>'$.totalAudioEnergy') :: double AS total_audio_energy,
  (rtc_data->>'$.totalSamplesDuration') :: double AS total_samples_duration,
  (rtc_data->>'$.estimatedPlayoutTimestamp') :: numeric AS estimated_playout_timestamp
FROM
  rtc_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id IN (${connection_id})
  AND rtc_id IN (${inbound_rtp_audio_rtc_id})
  AND (rtc_data->>'$.type') = 'inbound-rtp'
ORDER BY
  time
;

SELECT
  time_bucket($__interval, t.time) AS time,
  t.connection_id AS connection_id,
  t.inbound_rtp_audio_rtc_id AS inbound_rtp_audio_rtc_id,
  ((t.packets_received - lag(t.packets_received, 1, t.packets_received) OVER w) / $__interval_ms * 1000) :: numeric AS 'packetsReceived/s',
  ((t.bytes_received - lag(t.bytes_received, 1, t.bytes_received) OVER w) / $__interval_ms * 1000 * 8) :: numeric AS 'bytesReceived_in_bits/s',
  ((t.header_bytes_received - lag(t.header_bytes_received, 1, t.header_bytes_received) OVER w) / $__interval_ms * 1000 * 8) :: numeric AS 'headerBytesReceived_in_bits/s'
FROM (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    connection_id AS connection_id,
    rtc_id AS inbound_rtp_audio_rtc_id,
    (rtc_data->>'$.packetsReceived') :: numeric AS packets_received,
    (rtc_data->>'$.bytesReceived') :: numeric AS bytes_received,
    (rtc_data->>'$.headerBytesReceived') :: numeric AS header_bytes_received
  FROM rtc_stats
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND connection_id = ('${connection_id}')
    AND (rtc_data->>'$.id') IN ('${inbound_rtp_audio_rtc_id}')
    AND (rtc_data->>'$.type') = 'inbound-rtp'
  ORDER BY time
) AS t
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY t.connection_id, t.inbound_rtp_audio_rtc_id ORDER BY t.time)
ORDER BY time
;

WITH result AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    rtc_id,
  FROM rtc_stats
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND connection_id = '${connection_id}'
    AND rtc_type = 'inbound-rtp'
    AND (rtc_data->>'$.kind') = 'audio'
)
SELECT * FROM result
UNION ALL
SELECT ' '
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM result);
